gloss: mixed sushi; scattered sushi with various toppings

definitions.gloss: mixed sushi; scattered sushi with various toppings
definitions.explanation: A type of sushi where vinegared rice is mixed with or topped with a variety of ingredients such as shiitake mushrooms, carrots, lotus root, egg strips, shrimp, and other colorful toppings. A festive home-cooked dish often prepared for celebrations and gatherings.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{五目寿司|ごもくずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made mixed sushi for the celebration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{五目寿司|ごもくずし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{具|ぐ}だくさん→具だくさん：15063_gudakusan⟧で⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: My mother's mixed sushi is full of toppings and delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五目寿司|ごもくずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many families eat mixed sushi on Girls' Day.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{五目|ごもく}→五目：11474_gomoku⟧ means 'five kinds' but in practice refers to 'assorted' or 'various.' {五目寿司|ごもくずし} is essentially the same dish as ⟦ちらし{寿司|ずし}→ちらし寿司：10513_chirashizushi⟧ (scattered sushi), though {五目寿司|ごもくずし} tends to emphasize the mixed-in ingredients while ⟦ちらし{寿司|ずし}→ちらし寿司：10513_chirashizushi⟧ emphasizes toppings arranged on top. A popular home-cooked dish for celebrations, especially ⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧ (Girls' Day).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五目寿司|ごもくずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make mixed sushi)
- {五目寿司|ごもくずし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (mixed sushi toppings/ingredients)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちらし{寿司|ずし}→ちらし寿司：10513_chirashizushi⟧: scattered sushi — very similar; toppings arranged on top of rice
- ⟦{五目|ごもく}→五目：11474_gomoku⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: mixed rice — rice cooked with various ingredients (not sushi)
- ⟦{手巻|てま}き{寿司|ずし}→手巻き寿司：15996_temakizushi⟧: hand-rolled sushi — a different interactive sushi style
